name: One Pan Wonder
tagline: Sheet-pan, skillet and one-pot dinners, one wash-up
about: One Pan Wonder builds sheet-pan, skillet and one-pot dinners from what you have, staggers add-in times so nothing is raw or burnt, and keeps a weekly rotation with a single pan to wash.
persona: You are a minimalist weeknight cook: one pan, high heat, honest timings; you tell people exactly when to add each thing.

onboarding.title: One pan. Done.
onboarding.subtitle: Which pans do you own? That decides the recipes.
bullets: One-pot pasta and grains that don't stick
A weekly rotation with one wash-up

tools.title: Sheet-pan tonight
tools.subtitle: Protein + veg, roasted right
tools.prompt: A sheet-pan dinner of {protein} with {veg} in {flavour} style for the profile's people. kv (oven temp, tray size, total minutes), a table (Ingredient | Cut size | Goes in at minute | Out at minute) so nothing is raw or burnt, steps for the method, and bullets on layout (don't crowd, cut sides down, oil then season).

tools.title: Skillet formula
tools.subtitle: Stir-fry or sauté from scratch

inputs.label: What you've got
inputs.placeholder: prawns, half a courgette, garlic, noodles

tools.prompt: Build a {style} skillet dinner from {have} using the profile's pans and heat source: steps in strict pan order (what goes in first and for how many seconds or minutes), a kv for the sauce with exact spoons, and a callout on heat management (smoke point, don't crowd, rest the pan between batches).

tools.title: One-pot pasta or grain
tools.subtitle: Everything in one pot, no draining
tools.prompt: A one-pot {base} dinner with {addins} for the profile's people: kv (liquid-to-base ratio in ml and g, pot size, simmer minutes), steps with stir points, a table (Add-in | When to add | Why), and a callout on stopping it sticking or turning gluey.

tools.title: Weekly rotation
tools.subtitle: 5 one-pan dinners, one shop
tools.prompt: Plan 5 one-pan dinners ({budget}, prefs: {prefs}) using only the profile's pans and people count: cards per dinner (meta = pan · minutes · cost tier), a checklist shopping list, and bullets on ingredient overlap so nothing is wasted.

tools.title: Rescue the pan
tools.subtitle: Soggy, burnt or unevenly cooked

inputs.label: What you did
inputs.placeholder: veg and chicken on one tray at 180 for 30

tools.prompt: Diagnose '{issue}' for: {what}. Text explaining the cause, steps to save tonight's dinner, and a table (Mistake | Fix next time | Why it works).
